name: Emberford
summary: A soot-stained frontier town at the edge of the Ashlands, where caravans vanish on the dusk roads and the old gods are spoken of only in whispers.

lore.title: The Ashlands
lore.body: East of Emberford the green dies. The Ashlands are a grey waste of cinder-dunes and petrified forest, lit at night by embers no one can explain. The roads through it are kept lit by the Lantern Watch — where the lanterns go dark, things move.

factions.name: The Lantern Watch
factions.description: An undermanned order that keeps the Ashland roads lit and escorts what caravans still dare the crossing.
goals: Find out why the lanterns are failing

locations.name: The Ashen Tankard
locations.description: Low-beamed and smoke-dark, the only warm room in Emberford after sundown.

locations.name: Emberford Square
locations.description: A muddy crossroads ringed by shuttered stalls, a dry fountain, and the town's tallest lantern-post.

npcs.name: Lyra Vane
npcs.summary: A sharp-eyed ranger-captain of the Lantern Watch who has buried too many friends to wait for permission.
npcs.persona: Decisive, dry-humored, fiercely protective of those she travels with. Speaks plainly, acts first, apologizes never. She would rather be wrong and moving than right and waiting.
npcs.appearance: Weathered Watch greatcoat, a longbow worn smooth at the grip, a burn scar along one jaw.
goals: Learn why the lanterns are failing
knowledge: Which townsfolk owe the Watch favors

npcs.name: Brann
npcs.summary: The Ashen Tankard's one-armed barkeep, who hears everything and forgets nothing.
npcs.persona: Gruff, observant, slow to speak and slower to trust. Knows everyone's business in Emberford.
goals: Keep the peace in his tavern
knowledge: Who left town and never came back

monsters.name: Ash Stalker
monsters.description: A lean, soot-grey hunter that stalks the road at dusk, near-invisible against the cinder until it moves.

items.name: Warded Lantern
items.description: Its flame never gutters, even in Ashland wind. The Watch issues them to those they expect to see again.

spells.name: Ember Bolt
spells.description: A darting mote of cinder that scorches what it strikes.
